think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and allowed values from PostgreSQL documentation. 2) Check whether it is a numeric parameter with an inherent ordering. 3) If numeric, check whether any sentinel values (e.g., -1, 0) switch the behavior to a qualitatively different mode (disable/auto/special-case), breaking the natural order. 4) If the knob is not numeric (e.g., enum/string), it does not fit the “special numerical knob” definition; mark as not special under this definition. 5) If special, list the sentinel value(s); otherwise leave special_value null.
